description:
Configure Blender to produce a technical line drawing of the BMW car model using the Freestyle rendering engine.

Your tasks:
1. Enable 'Freestyle' in the Render Properties panel.
2. Configure the Freestyle Line Set in the View Layer Properties:
   - Set Line Thickness to a value between 2.0 and 5.0 pixels.
   - Ensure the Line Color is black (RGB 0, 0, 0).
3. Change the World Background color to White (RGB 1, 1, 1) to create high contrast.
4. Set the Render Resolution to 1920x1080.
5. Render the image (F12) and save it to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/line_art_render.png'.
6. Save the Blender project file to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/freestyle_setup.blend'.

The final result should look like a black-ink technical drawing on a clean white paper background.
